svg.text: KKFM TX shield - placement, top view, to scale
Plugs onto the Uno R3: adds no bench footprint beyond the Uno.
Stack-up: 2-layer 1.6 mm FR4. Bottom = unbroken GND pour.
Top = signals + GND fill, stitched every 5 mm and along edges.
RF / ESD rules built into the placement
1. Antenna exits top-left corner; Pi link enters bottom-left;
DAC jack exits right. No cable crosses another.
2. Red box: no copper on either layer under the antenna feed.
3. D2 sits on the ANT pad; its ground via is at the pad.
4. C1/C2 and R1/C5 sit at U1's pins, not at the Uno end.
5. I2S (R13-15) runs 6 mm from J5 to U2 on the edge away
from the antenna, over solid ground.
6. Audio filter R4-R7/C8-C9 sits between U2 side pins 7-9
and U1 LIN/RIN: 8 mm path. ROUT hops under LOUT on one
6 mm bottom trace, the only break in the plane.
7. D1 TVS at the 5 V entry, before either ferrite.
8. Every wire that was a 10-20 cm jumper is now <= 15 mm.
Uno R3 68.6 x 53.3, header rows 48.26 apart (hole pattern
per Arduino R3 reference). Si4713 breakout 1.5 x 0.75 in
MEASURE YOURS before fab, clones vary by ~1 mm.
Placement plan, not routed copper: no DRC has been run.
